_comment: Episode 2 narrative-continuity MEMORY (founder 2026-10-04: 'build a memory layer that helps with these kinds of logical nuances'). What the founder's cliff-to-hideout film ALREADY establishes, so in-game dialogue never repeats it. The dialogue system (FacilityShow via Ep2Canon) drops any line listed in redundant_after_film once the film has played. Extend this file as the story grows; it is the single source of truth for 'the game already told the player this'.

film_establishes.fact: Inferno Bull pulls Lil Blunt from the cliff wreck and revives him with whiskey.
Bull hands over the Winchester and the miner helmet for one Bitcoin.
The bears have overrun the Gold Mine, and Bull invites Lil Blunt to go bear hunting with him. THIS IS THE FILM'S CLOSING BEAT - do not restate it in the hideout.
